prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: shredded chicken, a corn can, cream cheese — one second still. Then motion: onion sizzling gold, chicken tossed through it, corn cascading in, cream cheese dolloped and melting into creamy streaks as the spoon folds. Money shot: the creamy mixture spooned into a bread roll split open, cheese grated over, then broiled — pulled out with the top bubbling, the filling oozing at the seams in macro, backlit steam. Final beat: the loaded roll lifted, filling stretching. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the corn cascade, then the creamy fold. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o cremoso de frango que salva sobra — vai de recheio de pão, de panqueca ou direto na colher. **Sábado que vem: [A] arroz, feijão de ontem e ovo ou [B] macarrão, molho de tomate e mussarela? Comenta A ou B 👇**
